stemMarkdown: The speeds of A and B are in the ratio 5 : 4. In a 100 m race, how many metres of a head start must A give B so that the race ends in a dead heat? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In the time A covers 100 m, B covers $100 \times \dfrac{4}{5} = 80.0000$ m. For a tie, B must be started ahead by the shortfall: $20.0$ m.
